variants.text: Face shape oval; jawline moderately defined; chin rounded, moderate projection, slight vertical height; hairline M-shaped, temporal recession; eyebrows medium thickness, soft-arched, low peak, moderate spacing, moderate brow-to-eye distance; eyes almond-shaped, moderate palpebral fissure length, horizontal slant, average inner corner distance, double moderate upper-lid crease, moderate lid exposure, average orbital depth; nasal root moderate width/depth; nasal dorsum straight; nasal bridge moderate width; nasal tip rounded, moderate projection/rotation; alar width moderate; alar flare moderate; nostrils partially visible; mouth width moderate; upper-to-lower lip ratio balanced; vermilion fullness moderate; cupid's bow defined; corners level; philtrum moderate length/width, defined ridges; upper dental alignment visible; ears average size, moderate protrusion, helix rolled, antihelix defined, lobes free, aligned with eye-nose line.

M-shaped hairline with temporal recession on an oval-shaped face featuring a moderate, rounded chin and a moderately defined jawline. The eyes are almond-shaped with a horizontal slant, double upper-lid creases of moderate height, and moderate lid exposure, set beneath soft-arched, medium-thickness eyebrows with a low peak. The nose has a straight dorsum, rounded tip with moderate projection, and partially visible nostrils. The mouth features a defined cupid's bow, balanced lip fullness, and visible upper dental alignment. Ears are of average size and protrusion with free lobes, aligned with the eye-nose line.
